title: The Story Behind MedInVedic — Founder History & Vision by Mahesh Badiger
content:
The Story Behind MedInVedic: Where Modern Medicine Meets Ancient Ayurveda.
Founder: Mahesh Badiger (Information Science and Engineering graduate).
MedInVedic started with a simple question: Why should people have to choose between modern medicine and Ayurveda when both can play a role in healthcare?
Healthcare was fragmented for everyday users searching online for medicine info, Ayurvedic remedies, home tips, nearby products, and doctor appointments across different platforms.
MedInVedic connects modern medicine (CDSCO/WHO), Ayurveda (AYUSH), AI Health Assistant, RAG knowledge retrieval, prescription verification, and doctor consultations in one unified ecosystem.
Website: https://medinvedic.web.app
Founder & Developer: Mahesh Badiger.
